[[Secretary/Legends|Secretary]] '''Greal''' was an individual who worked in [[Feris City]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Greal's employer became in need of the services of a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and Greal compiled a list of four possible candidates for the job: [[Lafek Iss]], [[Saulis Pau]], [[Quantana]] and [[Jasis Temm]].<ref name="Buyer's Market Galaxy Guide 10">{{WEGCite|story=Buyer's Market (Galaxy Guide 10)|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
